definitions.explanation: Hair that has lost its pigment and turned white or gray, usually due to aging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{白髪|しらが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えてきた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: I've been getting more gray hair recently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白髪|しらが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}めている→染める：04253_someru⟧。
examples.english: My mother dyes her gray hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}いのに→若い：00823_wakai⟧{白髪|しらが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あるのは→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{遺伝|いでん}→遺伝：noentry⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Having gray hair while young might be genetic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白髪|しらが}⟦でも→でも：noentry⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かす：noentry⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has white hair but is healthy and never misses his daily walk.

notes:
{白髪|しらが} refers to white or gray hair, typically associated with aging.

Common collocations:
- {白髪|しらが}が{増|ふ}える (to get more gray hair)
- {白髪|しらが}を{染|そ}める (to dye gray hair)
- {白髪|しらが}{交|ま}じり (graying, with some white hair)
- {若|わか}{白髪|しらが} (premature gray hair)

Alternative reading:
- {白髪|はくはつ} - more formal/literary reading

Related words:
- {白髪染|しらがぞ}め (gray hair dye)
- {銀髪|ぎんぱつ} (silver hair)
- グレイヘアー (gray hair - trendy term for embracing natural gray)
